title: Coordinating integration of multidisciplinary design analysis and optimisation codes with design structure matrices
abstract: arXiv:2611.22522v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The integrated analysis and optimisation codes used to design nuclear fusion reactors need to become increasingly large scale, multidisciplinary and complex to computationally verify design requirements more thoroughly and earlier in the design process. Though the manner in which the integrated models are coupled can have significant implications for computational efficiency, the structure of couplings typically remains hidden in the implementation of a design framework. As this problem is not unique to fusion, we frame integrated design problems as applications of the broader field of Multidisciplinary Design Analysis and Optimisation (MDAO). Originally developed for complex system design problems in e.g. aerospace, the MDAO field uses (extended) Design Structure Matrices (DSMs) to display the architecture of integrated analysis and optimisation codes. translated_title: 使用设计结构矩阵协调多学科设计分析与优化代码的集成
translated_abstract: 用于设计核聚变反应堆的集成分析与优化代码需要变得日益大规模、多学科且复杂，以便在设计流程中更早、更彻底地对设计需求进行计算验证。尽管集成模型的耦合方式对计算效率有重大影响，但耦合结构通常隐藏在设计框架的实现之中。由于这一问题并非聚变领域所独有，我们将集成设计问题构建为更广泛的多学科设计分析与优化（MDAO）领域的应用。MDAO领域最初是为航空航天等复杂系统设计问题而开发的，该领域使用（扩展的）设计结构矩阵（DSM）来展示集成分析与优化代码的架构。本工作的目的是介绍这些DSM方法，并演示它们如何（应用于聚变设计问题）。
tldr: 本文将核聚变反应堆的集成设计问题纳入多学科设计分析与优化（MDAO）框架，引入设计结构矩阵（DSM）来可视化和协调集成分析与优化代码的耦合架构，从而提升计算效率。
en_tdlr: This paper frames integrated fusion reactor design within the MDAO field and introduces Design Structure Matrices (DSMs) to visualize and coordinate the coupling architecture of integrated analysis and optimisation codes, improving computational efficiency.
